contextual_participants.source_general_rule: A complete participant mention supersedes its contained subspans unless a contained span has an independent role in the focused event. POPULATION is reserved for a focal group in a population comparison.

direction.source_general_rule: A study-activity statement that only names the subject investigated has direction NOT_APPLICABLE. OBSERVED requires an explicit non-directional biological finding.

direct_attachment.source_general_rule: Enumerate each event argument exactly once. If a required occurrence did not map, report attachment as blocked by occurrence instead of an independent attachment failure.

direct_participant_occurrence.source_general_rule: For a named gene or protein occurrence, do not expand the lexicalized name with an adjacent generic entity-type word unless that word is part of the name or is required to distinguish the source occurrence.

terminal.source_general_rule: Expose the active atomic terminal reason. A nonzero unsupported count with contradiction_count zero must not imply that a contradiction occurred.

uncertainty.source_general_rule: PROVISIONAL requires explicit provisional status. An unhedged study-activity statement is ASSERTED even when it reports no biological result.

unsupported_count.source_general_rule: Keep raw structural misses separate from independent unsupported scientific roots. A link that fails only because its target did not map is a cascade, not a second unsupported root.

no_tiebreak_reason: Both adjudicators reported no unresolved assigned issue and agreed exactly on shared classifications E_UNSUPPORTED_COUNT and F_TERMINAL_LABEL.
